poc_plan: Objective: validate Dedicated capacity for 100–400 rps chat + embeddings workload with predictable unit cost and <250ms p50 latency for short responses.
Duration: 8 weeks (2-week canary + 6-week ramp), target start: 2026-03-22
Canary: route 10% of prod traffic to Dedicated pool in us-east-1 for 2 weeks; metric gates: p50 latency <= 250ms, error rate <0.5%, 99th percentile latency regression <20% vs Hosted baseline.

Fallback routing: automatic fallback to Hosted API model variant in same region on capacity/excess error threshold; second-level failover to eu-west-1 for region outages (stateless requests routed via replica KV cache).

Model variants: primary = rdx-3b-quant (low cost), fallback = rdx-7b-fp16 (higher quality). SE will test A/B quality delta on 120-sample eval set; quality threshold: accept if BLEU-like/ROUGE-ish business metric delta <6% on critical prompts.
Rollback policy: immediate rollback if canary triggers >2 critical incidents in 24h or sustained cost delta >25% vs forecast. Rollback path: traffic re-route, node drain, postmortem within 48h.
Observability: token-level cost, per-route latency, tracing hooks, alerting to Slack channel #northbridge-poc and PagerDuty esc-policy for SREs.
Security ops: provide VPC peering window, exchange KMS access docs; audit log collection validated by week 1 of the POC.
tech_requirements: Throughput target: baseline 100 rps, burst 400 rps
Token cost sensitivity: aim to reduce per-token cost by 30% vs Hosted by using batching + quantized model variant
KV/prefix caching required for session reuse
SAML SSO for admin console, support for SCIM user sync
Region failover: primary us-east-1, secondary eu-west-1 (for EU-customer sessions)
Audit logs retention: 90 days by default, 1 year optional add-on
decision_criteria: Performance: meets latency SLOs under 1x and 3x production traffic
Cost: projected ARR savings >=20% for committed contract
Security: KMS support, SOC2 + SAML, audit logs verified
Operational: simple rollback paths and clear routing/fallback policies
Quality: no significant regression for core KB retrieval and assistant prompts
